protocol.tracks: Road centre plus four authoritative Taycan wheel centres in every logical lane, excluding only the first/last 2m where cross-road continuation is validated separately.
protocol.surfaceQuery: Actual CityGround.sampleRoadSurface with rendered-floor height reference; topology and layer selection unchanged. Grounded/rejection/impulse data come from the separate dynamic replays.
protocol.render: Existing RoadEdgeChain ribbon triangles and junction surfaces; excludes the intentional 24mm visual paint lift. Float32 render-vertex comparison recorded separately.
protocol.headless: All authored road/junction pavements retained. Only furniture and visual terrain extents reduced; terrain-return queries are flagged as missing pavement and excluded from the height-error statistic.
